Al-Hasakah | Turkish missile injures woman in Tal Tamr

SOHR reliable sources have reported that a woman has been wounded in missile fire conducted by the Turkish forces on villages of Tal Shinan, Al-Ashouriyah, Om AL-Khir and Dishisha in Tal Tamr in Al-Hasakah province.

Earlier, sources reported heavy missile attack conducted by the Turkish forces on Tal Shinan Al-Ashouriyah in Tal Tamr countryside in Al-Hasakah countryside.

On Friday, SOHR reliable sources monitored missile fire by the Turkish forces on areas in Ain Essa countryside, the capital of “the Autonomous Administration in north and north-east Syria” that is located in north Al-Raqqah countryside. The attack also hit Hoshan village and its surroundings. But, no casualties reported.
